
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/funkyd/p/21409481" title="发布于 2026-07-13 14:07">
    
        <img src="/images/aigc-marker.svg" class="text-front-icon" title="本文内容由AI生成" alt="AIGC标识">

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">记一次 Cloudflared Tunnel 在 Docker 中 DNS 解析异常的排查与解决</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2><span>背景</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>近期在家庭 NAS（Debian 12）上通过 Docker 部署 Cloudflare Tunnel（cloudflared），用于将内网服务安全暴露到公网。按照官方文档编写的 <code>docker-compose.yml</code><span> 启动后，容器却一直报错，无法连接 Cloudflare 边缘节点。经过一系列排查，最终定位到 Docker 内部 DNS 解析机制的异常，并通过挂载宿主机 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span> 绕过了问题。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>本文将完整记录排查过程、原理分析和最终方案，希望对遇到类似问题的朋友有所帮助。</span></p>
<h2><span>环境信息</span></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">宿主机<span>：Debian 12 (bookworm)</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">Docker<span>：24.x（使用 Docker Compose v2）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">镜像<span>：<code>cloudflare/cloudflared:latest</code></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">网络拓扑<span>：移动宽带 → 光猫 → 主路由器 → WiFi 桥接从路由器 → NAS（有线连接）</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><span>问题现象</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>执行 <code>docker-compose up -d</code><span> 后，查看容器日志：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">docker logs cloudflared-tunnel</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>输出大量如下错误：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>ERR edge discovery: error looking up Cloudflare edge IPs: the DNS query failed 
error="lookup _v2-origintunneld._tcp.argotunnel.com on [::1]:53: read udp [::1]:40423-&gt;[::1]:53: read: connection refused"</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>关键点：DNS 查询目标地址为 <code>[::1]:53</code><span>（IPv6 本地回环），但宿主机并未监听该端口，导致连接拒绝。</span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span>排查过程</span></h2>
<h3><span>1. 检查宿主机 DNS 配置</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>首先确认宿主机自身能否正常解析 Cloudflare 所需的 SRV 记录：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">cat /etc/resolv.conf
<span class="token comment"># nameserver 192.168.10.1  （网关）

<span class="token function">dig srv _origintunneld._tcp.argotunnel.com @192.168.10.1
<span class="token comment"># 返回有效 SRV 记录，说明 DNS 可用</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>宿主机 DNS 工作正常，问题在容器内部。</span></p>
<hr>
<h3><span>2. 检查容器内的 DNS 设置</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>通过 <code>docker inspect</code><span> 查看容器的 DNS 配置（初期使用默认桥接模式）：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">docker inspect cloudflared-tunnel <span class="token operator">| <span class="token function">grep <span class="token parameter variable">-A <span class="token number">5 <span class="token string">"Dns"</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>输出显示 <code>Dns</code><span> 为 <code>null</code><span>，即使用 Docker 默认的 DNS 机制。查看容器内的 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span>：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">docker <span class="token function">cp cloudflared-tunnel:/etc/resolv.conf /tmp/container-resolv.conf
<span class="token function">sudo <span class="token function">cat /tmp/container-resolv.conf</span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>内容如下：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">text</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre>nameserver 127.0.0.11
options ndots:0</pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>127.0.0.11</code><span> 是 Docker 内置的 DNS 解析器，用于容器间的服务发现和外部 DNS 转发。正常情况下，它应该将请求转发到宿主机 DNS。</span></p>
<hr>
<h3><span>3. 尝试指定 DNS 服务器（失败）</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在 Compose 中添加 <code>dns</code><span> 项，明确指定 <code>192.168.10.1</code><span> 和 <code>1.1.1.1</code><span>：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">yaml</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token key atrule">dns<span class="token punctuation">:
  <span class="token punctuation">- 192.168.10.1
  <span class="token punctuation">- 1.1.1.1</span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>重新 <code>down</code><span> + <code>up</code><span> 后，再次查看容器内 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span>，发现依然只有 <code>127.0.0.11</code><span>，但注释中出现 <code># ExtServers: [192.168.10.1 1.1.1.1]</code><span>，说明 Docker 将外部 DNS 作为上游，但容器内 resolv.conf 仍指向自己的 stub resolver。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">错误依然存在<span>，且始终指向 <code>[::1]:53</code><span>，说明 Docker 内置 DNS 在转发时错误地尝试了 IPv6 回环。</span></span></p>
<hr>
<h3><span>4. 尝试 <code>host</code><span> 网络模式（仍失败）</span></span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>既然桥接模式有问题，尝试让容器直接使用宿主机网络栈：</span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">yaml</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token key atrule">network_mode<span class="token punctuation">: host</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>重新部署后，容器内 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span> 与宿主机完全一致（<code>nameserver 192.168.10.1</code><span>）。但 错误依然不变<span>，仍然尝试连接 <code>[::1]:53</code><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>这很奇怪，因为宿主机不存在 IPv6 回环监听。怀疑 <code>cloudflared</code><span> 程序内部可能硬编码了 IPv6 优先逻辑，或 Go 运行时（<code>net</code><span> 包）在某种条件下优先尝试 IPv6。</span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h3><span>5. 确认宿主机默认 DNS 解析正常</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>即使 <code>host</code><span> 模式，<code>cloudflared</code><span> 似乎仍忽略 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span>。执行：</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">bash</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token function">dig srv _origintunneld._tcp.argotunnel.com
<span class="token comment"># 返回有效记录，使用 192.168.10.1</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>说明宿主机解析完全正常，问题仅限于容器内的 <code>cloudflared</code><span> 进程。</span></span></p>
<hr>
<h3><span>6. 最终手段：挂载宿主机 resolv.conf 并强制使用 Go 原生解析器</span></h3>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>经过搜索和阅读相关 issue（如 <a href="https://github.com/golang/go/issues/27546" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank"><span>golang/go#27546</span></a><span>），发现 Go 程序的 DNS 解析可能受 cgo<span>（调用系统 <code>getaddrinfo</code><span>）影响，有时不遵守 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span>。而通过环境变量 <code>GODEBUG=netdns=go</code><span> 可强制 Go 使用自己的纯 Go 解析器，直接读取 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span>。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>同时，为了彻底避免 Docker 干预，直接挂载宿主机的 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span> 到容器内，覆盖 Docker 自动生成的文件。</span></span></p>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>修改后的 <code>docker-compose.yml</code><span>：</span></span></p>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">yaml</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token key atrule">version<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token string">'3.8'
<span class="token key atrule">services<span class="token punctuation">:
  <span class="token key atrule">cloudflared<span class="token punctuation">:
    <span class="token key atrule">image<span class="token punctuation">: cloudflare/cloudflared<span class="token punctuation">:latest
    <span class="token key atrule">container_name<span class="token punctuation">: cloudflared<span class="token punctuation">-tunnel
    <span class="token key atrule">volumes<span class="token punctuation">:
      <span class="token punctuation">- /etc/resolv.conf<span class="token punctuation">:/etc/resolv.conf<span class="token punctuation">:ro   <span class="token comment"># 挂载宿主机 DNS 配置
    <span class="token key atrule">environment<span class="token punctuation">:
      <span class="token punctuation">- GODEBUG=netdns=go                       <span class="token comment"># 强制使用纯 Go 解析器
    <span class="token key atrule">command<span class="token punctuation">: tunnel <span class="token punctuation">-<span class="token punctuation">-no<span class="token punctuation">-autoupdate run <span class="token punctuation">-<span class="token punctuation">-token $<span class="token punctuation">{CLOUDFLARED_TOKEN<span class="token punctuation">}
    <span class="token key atrule">restart<span class="token punctuation">: unless<span class="token punctuation">-stopped</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>重新部署后，容器内 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span> 内容变为宿主机的 <code>nameserver 192.168.10.1</code><span>，且 <code>cloudflared</code><span> 成功解析并建立隧道。</span></span></span></span></p>
<hr>
<h2><span>问题根源分析</span></h2>
<h3><span>Docker DNS 机制</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>Docker 默认在每个容器内启动一个 DNS stub resolver（监听 <code>127.0.0.11</code><span>），用于解析容器名和外部域名。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>该 stub 从宿主机 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span> 或 Compose 的 <code>dns</code><span> 字段获取上游 DNS。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>在特定环境下（如 IPv6 未正确配置），该 stub 可能错误地尝试向 <code>::1</code><span> 发送查询，导致失败。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><code>host</code><span> 网络模式的局限</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>host</code><span> 模式虽然共享宿主机网络栈，但容器内进程仍受其自身运行时环境影响（如 glibc 的 <code>gai.conf</code><span>、NSS 配置）。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>cloudflared</code><span>（Go 程序）默认使用 cgo 解析器<span>（调用系统 <code>getaddrinfo</code><span>），可能会根据系统配置（如 <code>gai.conf</code><span> 中的 <code>precedence</code><span>）优先尝试 IPv6，即使 <code>/etc/resolv.conf</code><span> 只包含 IPv4 DNS。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>为什么挂载 + <code>GODEBUG</code><span> 有效</span></span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>挂载覆盖了 Docker 生成的 <code>resolv.conf</code><span>，确保容器直接使用有效的 IPv4 DNS。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>GODEBUG=netdns=go</code><span> 强制 Go 使用纯 Go 实现，完全绕开系统 NSS 和 <code>getaddrinfo</code><span>，直接读取 <code>resolv.conf</code><span> 并按顺序尝试，不再受到 IPv6 偏好影响。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span>解决方案总结</span></h2>
<h3><span>推荐配置（稳定可用）</span></h3>
<div class="md-code-block md-code-block-light">
<div class="md-code-block-banner-wrap">
<div class="md-code-block-banner md-code-block-banner-lite">
<div class="_121d384">
<div class="d2a24f03"><span class="d813de27">yaml</span></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<pre><span class="token key atrule">version<span class="token punctuation">: <span class="token string">'3.8'
<span class="token key atrule">services<span class="token punctuation">:
  <span class="token key atrule">cloudflared<span class="token punctuation">:
    <span class="token key atrule">image<span class="token punctuation">: cloudflare/cloudflared<span class="token punctuation">:latest
    <span class="token key atrule">container_name<span class="token punctuation">: cloudflared<span class="token punctuation">-tunnel
    <span class="token key atrule">volumes<span class="token punctuation">:
      <span class="token punctuation">- /etc/resolv.conf<span class="token punctuation">:/etc/resolv.conf<span class="token punctuation">:ro
    <span class="token key atrule">environment<span class="token punctuation">:
      <span class="token punctuation">- GODEBUG=netdns=go
    <span class="token key atrule">command<span class="token punctuation">: tunnel <span class="token punctuation">-<span class="token punctuation">-no<span class="token punctuation">-autoupdate run <span class="token punctuation">-<span class="token punctuation">-token $<span class="token punctuation">{CLOUDFLARED_TOKEN<span class="token punctuation">}
    <span class="token key atrule">restart<span class="token punctuation">: unless<span class="token punctuation">-stopped</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></pre>
</div>
<h3><span>关键点</span></h3>
<ul>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">不要使用<span> <code>network_mode: host</code><span> 或 <code>dns</code><span> 显式指定，除非您明确了解其行为。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>挂载宿主机 <code>resolv.conf</code><span> 是最直接的方式，确保容器与宿主机使用相同 DNS。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>环境变量 <code>GODEBUG=netdns=go</code><span> 可避免 Go 程序受系统 IPv6 偏好影响，提高兼容性。</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2><span>经验教训</span></h2>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">DNS 问题是容器化常见陷阱<span>：容器网络命名空间和 DNS 转发机制有时会引入意外行为，需要深入理解 Docker 网络模型。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><code>host</code><span> 网络并非万能<span>：虽然省去端口映射，但容器进程仍受自身运行时和系统库影响。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>环境变量 <code>GODEBUG</code><span> 是排查 Go 网络问题的利器<span>：可快速切换解析器，判断是否是 cgo 引起的问题。</span></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>用 <code>dig</code><span>、<code>docker cp</code><span> 等工具逐步验证<span>：不盲目猜测，通过数据确认每一层配置是否生效。</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ol><hr>
<h2><span>结语</span></h2>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph"><span>通过这次排查，不仅解决了 <code>cloudflared</code><span> 的部署问题，也对 Docker DNS 和 Go 网络栈有了更深入的理解。希望本文能帮助到同样踩过此坑的开发者。如果您有更好的解法或经验，欢迎交流讨论。</span></span></p>
<hr>
<p class="ds-markdown-paragraph">博客园首发<span>，转载注明出处。</span></p>
